sources.exact_technical_claims: Proves that Canonical Signed Digit (CSD) representation using digits {-1, 0, +1} with no two adjacent non-zero digits minimizes non-zero terms (33% fewer than two's complement), allowing constant multiplication to decompose into wired bit-shifts and a single carry-save adder.
